教学法研究（由 pedagogic 加表示「学问」的后缀构成）

senses.title: Relating to teaching methods
senses.definition: concerned with how teaching is organised, explained or assessed
senses.definitionCN: 关乎教学如何组织、讲解与评价
senses.example: The new teacher treated the lesson plan as a pedagogical experiment rather than a script.
senses.exampleCN: 这位新老师把教案当作一次教学法实验，而不是照本宣科的脚本。
senses.why: The adjective attaches the Greek field of teaching to any decision about how a lesson is built.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词把希腊语的教学领域接到任何关于课程如何搭建的决定上。

senses.title: Pedagogical research
senses.definition: research that investigates how teaching affects learning, often with classrooms as its evidence
senses.definitionCN: 考察教学如何影响学习的研究，常以课堂为证据
senses.example: Pedagogical research compared two ways of introducing fractions.
senses.exampleCN: 教学法研究比较了两种引入分数的方式。
senses.why: The adjective marks the research as about teaching rather than about the subject being taught.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词标出研究关乎教学，而非被教的学科本身。

senses.title: Pedagogical training
senses.definition: preparation for teachers in how to teach, as distinct from training in their subject
senses.definitionCN: 教师在教学方式上的准备，区别于学科本身的训练
senses.example: The programme added pedagogical training for new lecturers.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目为新讲师增加了教学法训练。
senses.why: A brilliant scholar may still need pedagogical training, because knowing a subject and teaching it are different skills.
senses.whyCN: 出色的学者仍可能需要教学法训练，因为懂一门学科与教这门学科是不同技能。

senses.title: Pedagogical design
senses.definition: the intentional arrangement of tasks, materials and sequence to produce learning
senses.definitionCN: 为产生学习而有意安排任务、材料与顺序
senses.example: The software's pedagogical design decides when hints appear.
senses.exampleCN: 这款软件的教学法设计决定提示何时出现。
senses.why: Design carries teaching even when no teacher is present, so the adjective moves into materials and tools.
senses.whyCN: 即使没有教师在场，设计也承载教学，因此这个形容词进入材料与工具。

senses.title: A pedagogical purpose
senses.definition: an aim that concerns learning rather than administration, entertainment or assessment alone
senses.definitionCN: 关乎学习、而非仅关乎行政、娱乐或评价的目的
senses.example: The field trip had a pedagogical purpose, not merely a recreational one.
senses.exampleCN: 这次实地参观有教学目的，而不只是娱乐。
senses.why: The adjective distinguishes why something is done: the test is whether learning is the point.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词区分做某事的原因：检验标准是学习是否为目的。

senses.title: Pedagogical theory
senses.definition: the body of ideas about how instruction should work and why
senses.definitionCN: 关于教学应当如何运作及其原因的观念体系
senses.example: Her pedagogical theory begins with the mistakes students make.
senses.exampleCN: 她的教学理论从学生的错误开始。
senses.why: Theory gives the adjective a formal object: not a single method but a system of explanation.
senses.whyCN: 理论给这个形容词一个正式对象：不是单一方法，而是一套解释体系。

senses.title: Pedagogical value or judgment
senses.definition: the worth of an activity or decision judged by what it teaches
senses.definitionCN: 按某活动或决定能教什么来判定的价值
senses.example: The game has pedagogical value, but only if someone names the pattern afterwards.
senses.exampleCN: 这个游戏有教学价值，但前提是事后有人点明其中的模式。
senses.why: The adjective lets teachers evaluate ordinary materials by asking what learning they make possible.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词让教师通过追问「它使何种学习成为可能」来评价日常材料。

senses.title: Abstract: arranged for learning
senses.definition: deliberately arranged so that learning is more likely, whether or not a teacher is present
senses.definitionCN: 有意安排以使学习更可能，无论是否有教师在场
senses.example: A well-built staircase can be pedagogical: it teaches the body a rhythm.
senses.exampleCN: 一段造得好的楼梯也可以是教学性的：它教会身体一种节奏。
senses.why: At its widest the adjective names intention in the arrangement, not a classroom or a profession.
senses.whyCN: 推到最宽处，这个形容词命名安排中的意图，而非教室或职业。

intro.en: Pedagogical is pedagogy plus the adjective ending -ical, which came from Greek through Latin and French. Pedagogy itself comes from Greek paidagogia, 'attendance on a boy'. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: pedagogical 是 pedagogy 加形容词词尾构成，这个词尾经拉丁与法语来自希腊语。pedagogy 本身来自希腊语 paidagogia「照看男孩」。年代均为约数。

items.en: Paidagogos named the slave who escorted a boy to school; the word named a person before it named a field.
items.cn: paidagogos 指护送男孩上学的家奴；这个词先命名人，后命名领域。

items.en: The Greek ending -ikos meant 'of, belonging to'. It built adjectives from nouns across the language.
items.cn: 希腊词尾 -ikos 意为「属于……的」。它在整个语言中由名词构成形容词。

items.en: Latin took the ending as -icus, which passed into academic and technical vocabulary.
items.cn: 拉丁语把这个词尾接受为 -icus，再传入学术与技术语汇。

items.en: French reshaped the ending as -ique, and English borrowed many such adjectives through French.
items.cn: 法语把词尾改写为 -ique，英语经法语借入许多这类形容词。

items.en: English added -al to the older -ic form, producing pairs such as pedagogic and pedagogical.
items.cn: 英语在较早的 -ic 形式后加 -al，形成 pedagogic 与 pedagogical 这样的成对形式。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the adjective is recorded from the eighteenth century, but its spread in education and design is later.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：这个形容词自十八世纪有记录，但它在教育与设计领域的普及更晚。

note.en: Group one separates the adjective from its shorter form and from a look-alike Greek compound; group two holds the near adjectives for teaching.
note.cn: 第一组把这个形容词与它的短形式、以及一个希腊语形近复合词分开；第二组是表示教学的近义形容词。

entries.definition: The older adjective without the extra ending; it means the same but sounds more technical and less common.
entries.definitionCN: 不带额外词尾的较早形容词；意思相同，却更技术化、较少用。

entries.definition: The field or practice; the adjective describes anything that belongs to it.
entries.definitionCN: 领域或实践；形容词描述属于它的事物。

entries.definition: From dēmos 'people' plus agein 'lead': appealing to a crowd by emotion. It shares the ending, not the child stem.
entries.definitionCN: 由 dēmos「人民」加 agein「引导」构成：以情绪诉诸人群。它共享词尾，却不共享「孩子」词干。

entries.definition: Relating to children's medicine, from pais 'child' plus iatreia 'healing'; it shares paid- but not agein.
entries.definitionCN: 与儿童医学有关，由 pais「孩子」加 iatreia「治疗」构成；它共享 paid-，却不共享 agein。

entries.definition: Relating to education as a whole system; pedagogical is narrower and points at teaching method.
entries.definitionCN: 与整个教育制度有关；pedagogical 更窄，指向教学方法。

entries.definition: Designed to instruct or deliver content; it stresses transmission more than reflection on teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 为教导或传递内容而设计；它比教学反思更强调传递。

entries.definition: From Greek didaskein 'to teach'; it often implies a lecturing or moralising tone.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊语 didaskein「教」；常含说教或道德训诫的语气。

entries.definition: Relating to study or scholarship; it describes the world of learning rather than the method of teaching.
entries.definitionCN: 与学习或学术有关；它描述学习世界，而非教学方法。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real suffixes and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的词尾与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Pedagogy is the field, and the extra ending turns it into an adjective.
normal.cn: pedagogy 是领域，额外词尾把它变成形容词。

normal.en: The -ic and -ical pair is common in English, as in historic and historical.
normal.cn: -ic 与 -ical 的成对形式在英语里很常见，如 historic 与 historical。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark the uses: pedagogical research, pedagogical training, pedagogical design.
normal.cn: 固定说法标出用法：教学法研究、教学法训练、教学法设计。

normal.en: Pais means child and agein means lead; the adjective still points at the guiding of a learner.
normal.cn: pais 意为孩子，agein 意为引导；这个形容词仍指向对学习者的引导。

normal.en: Pedagogical can describe a tool or a staircase, because design itself can teach.
normal.cn: pedagogical 可以描述工具甚至楼梯，因为设计本身就能教。

abstract.en: Picture a lesson plan with notes in every margin, like a builder's drawing.
abstract.cn: 想象一份教案，每页边角都写满批注，像建筑师的施工图。

abstract.en: Picture a hint appearing on a screen exactly when a learner is about to give up.
abstract.cn: 想象屏幕上恰在学习者要放弃时出现一条提示。

abstract.en: Picture a staircase whose steps teach the body a rhythm without saying a word.
abstract.cn: 想象一段楼梯不说一句话，却教会身体一种节奏。

examples.en: The journal publishes pedagogical research alongside subject studies.
examples.cn: 这份期刊把教学法研究与学科研究并列发表。

examples.en: New lecturers often need pedagogical training more than more subject knowledge.
examples.cn: 新讲师常更需要教学法训练，而不是更多学科知识。

examples.en: The app's pedagogical design hides the answer until the learner has tried twice.
examples.cn: 这款应用的教学法设计会在学习者尝试两次后才显示答案。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「派达 够 吉 扣」——给孩子引路的那门学问的 → 教学法的

root: 希腊 pais「孩子」+ agein「引导」→ paidagogos → paidagogia；再加经拉丁与法语来的形容词词尾 -ical。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with teaching method, then move to research, teacher training, design, purpose, theory, value judgments and finally any arrangement made for learning.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从教学方法出发，转到研究、教师训练、设计、目的、理论、价值判断，最后是任何为学习而做的安排。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a lesson plan annotated like a builder's drawing, every pause and question marked.
core.cn: 核心意象：一份像施工图那样批注的教案，每处停顿与提问都被标出。

branches.en: METHOD AND DESIGN: how a lesson is organised, and how materials are arranged to teach.
branches.cn: 方法与设计：课程如何组织，材料如何安排以产生教学。

branches.en: RESEARCH AND THEORY: evidence about teaching, and the system of ideas behind it.
branches.cn: 研究与理论：关于教学的证据，以及其背后的观念体系。

branches.en: TRAINING: teachers learn method separately from their subject.
branches.cn: 训练：教师把方法从学科中单独学习。

branches.en: PURPOSE AND VALUE: why an activity is done, and what it is worth by what it teaches.
branches.cn: 目的与价值：为何做某活动，以及按它能教什么来判定价值。

branches.en: INTENTION: the widest reading names any arrangement made so that learning is more likely.
branches.cn: 意图：最宽的读法命名任何为使学习更可能而做的安排。

intro.en: Pedagogical stacks a Greek noun of child-leading with a suffix chain that runs through Latin and French into English.
intro.cn: pedagogical 把一个表示「引导孩子」的希腊名词，与一条经拉丁、法语进入英语的词尾链叠在一起。

latinIntro.en: Greek pais and agein give paidagogos and paidagogia; the ending -ikos becomes Latin -icus, French -ique and English -ical.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 pais 与 agein 构成 paidagogos 与 paidagogia；词尾 -ikos 变成拉丁 -icus、法语 -ique 与英语 -ical。

definition_zh: 教师；（常含贬义）卖弄学问的教书匠；历史上指护送男孩上学的家奴
definition_en: a teacher, often one who is pedantic; historically a household slave who escorted a boy to school
core_image: 一个年长的仆人提着灯，走在前头，把男孩送到学堂门口，然后等在墙外
scene: 古罗马的家庭里，一名受过教育的奴仆每天清晨提着灯，把孩子送到学堂再回家。In a Roman household, a pedagogue walked the boy to school each morning and waited outside.
sceneCN: 这里 pedagogue 指历史上负责护送并照看男孩的家奴（第 5 个义项：古代护送男孩上学的家仆）；句意为在古罗马家庭中，一名教仆每天早晨把孩子送到学校并在外面等候。

senses.title: A schoolmaster
senses.definition: a teacher, especially an old-fashioned or formal name for a schoolmaster
senses.definitionCN: 教师，尤指旧式或正式的校长、教书先生称呼
senses.example: The village pedagogue taught every child in one room.
senses.exampleCN: 村里的教书先生在一间屋里教所有孩子。
senses.why: This is the oldest English sense after the word entered from Latin: the person in charge of teaching.
senses.whyCN: 这是这个词从拉丁语进入英语后最古老的义：负责教学的人。

senses.title: A pedantic teacher
senses.definition: a teacher who insists on formal rules and displays learning rather than helping students learn
senses.definitionCN: 坚持形式规则、炫耀学问而不帮助学生学习的教师
senses.example: The new head was a pedagogue who corrected visitors' grammar.
senses.exampleCN: 新校长是个教书匠，连来访者的语法都要纠正。
senses.why: The word acquired a sneer: teaching that becomes showing off turns the title into an insult.
senses.whyCN: 这个词带上了讥讽：当教学变成炫耀，这个称号就变成侮辱。

senses.title: A college teacher
senses.definition: a formal or literary word for a teacher at a college or university
senses.definitionCN: 对学院或大学教师的正式或书面称呼
senses.example: The committee included a pedagogue from the medical school.
senses.exampleCN: 委员会包括一位来自医学院的教师。
senses.why: In elevated prose the word can still name the profession without any sneer.
senses.whyCN: 在正式书面语中，这个词仍可中性地命名这一职业。

senses.title: An educational thinker or writer
senses.definition: a person who writes about teaching and learning rather than only practising it
senses.definitionCN: 写作论述教学与学习、而不只是实践的人
senses.example: The old pedagogue's essays were read long after his school closed.
senses.exampleCN: 那位老教育家的文章在他学校关闭很久后仍被阅读。
senses.why: Writing about teaching extends the person-word from the classroom to the study.
senses.whyCN: 写作论述教学把这个指人的词从教室延伸到书房。

senses.title: The ancient slave escort
senses.definition: the household slave in ancient Greece who walked a boy to school, carried his things and supervised him
senses.definitionCN: 古希腊负责送男孩上学、拿东西并照看他的家奴
senses.example: In a Roman household, a pedagogue walked the boy to school each morning and waited outside.
senses.exampleCN: 在古罗马家庭中，一名教仆每天早晨把孩子送到学校并在外面等候。
senses.why: The original Greek word named this servant, so the modern teacher sense is a later promotion of the escort.
senses.whyCN: 最初的希腊词命名这名仆役，因此现代教师义是这一护送者身份后来的升格。

senses.title: A drillmaster
senses.definition: a person who drills others in a routine, often with little concern for understanding
senses.definitionCN: 让人反复操练一套程序、常不顾理解的人
senses.example: The choir's pedagogue drilled the same phrase for an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 合唱团的教练把同一乐句练了一个小时。
senses.why: When teaching is reduced to repetition, the word slides from instructor to drillmaster.
senses.whyCN: 当教学被缩减为重复，这个词就从教师滑向操练者。

senses.title: A symbol of educational authority
senses.definition: a figure who stands for the authority of the school over the learner
senses.definitionCN: 代表学校对学习者拥有权威的形象
senses.example: In the novel, the pedagogue is a figure of fear rather than help.
senses.exampleCN: 在这部小说里，教师是令人畏惧而非助人的形象。
senses.why: Literature uses the word as a type, so it can name an office rather than a particular person.
senses.whyCN: 文学把这个词当作类型使用，因此它可以命名一种职位，而非特定个人。

senses.title: Abstract: anyone who leads a learner
senses.titleCN: 抽象义：任何引导学习者的人
senses.definition: any person who takes charge of leading someone toward knowledge
senses.definitionCN: 任何负责把某人引向知识的人
senses.example: Every good editor is something of a pedagogue.
senses.exampleCN: 每个好编辑都有点像教师。
senses.why: At its widest the word returns to the Greek image of leading, without the school or the sneer.
senses.whyCN: 推到最宽处，这个词回到希腊语的「引导」意象，既无学校，也无讥讽。

intro.en: Pedagogue comes from Greek paidagogos, 'the slave who led a boy to school', built on pais 'child' and agein 'to lead', through Latin paedagogus. Dates are approximate.
intro.cn: pedagogue 来自希腊语 paidagogos「送男孩上学的家奴」，由 pais「孩子」与 agein「引导」构成，经拉丁 paedagogus 进入英语。年代均为约数。

items.en: Pais, stem paid-, meant 'child, boy'. The same stem is behind pediatrics and pedagogy.
items.cn: pais 的词干是 paid-，意为「孩子、男孩」。同一词干也构成 pediatrics 与 pedagogy。

items.en: Agein meant 'to lead, drive'. It supplies the guiding half of the compound.
items.cn: agein 意为「引导、驱赶」。它提供这个复合词中「引导」的一半。

items.en: Paidagogos was the household slave who escorted a boy to school, carried his books and watched him on the way.
items.cn: paidagogos 是护送男孩上学、拿书本并沿途照看的家奴。

items.en: Latin borrowed paedagogus, keeping the servant sense and also using it for a teacher or tutor.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入 paedagogus，保留仆役义，也用它指教师或导师。

items.en: English pedagogue is recorded from the sixteenth century, first as a schoolmaster and later as a learned teacher.
items.cn: 英语 pedagogue 自十六世纪有记录，先指校长或教师，后指有学问的教书人。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date): the sneering sense of a pedantic teacher developed later and is generally dated to the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 来源不确定（首见年代）：指卖弄学问的教师这一讥讽义后来才出现，一般认为在十九世纪。

note.en: Group one separates the person from the field and its adjectives, and from two Greek look-alikes; group two holds the neutral names for a teacher.
note.cn: 第一组把人称词与领域词、形容词分开，并区分两个希腊语形近词；第二组是教师的中性名称。

entries.definition: The theory or practice of teaching, not the person who teaches.
entries.definitionCN: 教学的理论或实践，不是教书的人。

entries.definition: Relating to teaching methods; a pedagogue is the person, pedagogical is the manner.
entries.definitionCN: 与教学方法有关；pedagogue 是人，pedagogical 是方式。

entries.definition: From dēmos 'people' plus agogos 'leader': a leader who appeals to a crowd's emotions. It shares the leader half, not the child half.
entries.definitionCN: 由 dēmos「人民」加 agogos「引导者」构成：诉诸人群情绪的领袖。它共享「引导者」一半，不共享「孩子」一半。

entries.definition: A person who displays book learning; it may be connected through French and Italian to pedagogue, but the link is not certain.
entries.definitionCN: 炫耀书本学问的人；它可能经法语与意大利语与 pedagogue 有关，但这一联系并不确定。

entries.definition: The plain name for a person who teaches; pedagogue is more formal and can sound old-fashioned or scornful.
entries.definitionCN: 教人者的朴素名称；pedagogue 更正式，也可能显得旧式或轻蔑。

entries.definition: A formal name for a teaching professional; it does not carry the sneer that pedagogue can carry.
entries.definitionCN: 对教育专业人员的正式称呼；不带 pedagogue 可能带的讥讽。

entries.definition: A person who instructs in a skill or course; it is practical and neutral.
entries.definitionCN: 在技能或课程中指导的人；实用而中性。

entries.definition: An old-fashioned word for a male teacher or head of a school; it overlaps with the first sense of pedagogue.
entries.definitionCN: 对男教师或校长的旧式称呼；与 pedagogue 的第一个义项重叠。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: real morphemes, real Greek words and real relatives, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的构词成分、真实的希腊词与真实的同族词，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: Pais means child and agein means lead, so the pedagogue was the one who led the child.
normal.cn: pais 意为孩子，agein 意为引导，所以 pedagogue 就是引导孩子的人。

normal.en: The original pedagogue was a slave, not a professor: the word began with feet on the road.
normal.cn: 最初的 pedagogue 是家奴，不是教授：这个词开始于走在路上的脚。

normal.en: Fixed phrases carry the tone: a strict pedagogue, a pedantic pedagogue, a progressive pedagogue.
normal.cn: 固定说法带着语气：严厉的教师、卖弄学问的教书匠、主张进步的教师。

normal.en: Pedagogy is the field and pedagogical the adjective, but pedagogue is only the person.
normal.cn: pedagogy 是领域，pedagogical 是形容词，而 pedagogue 只指人。

normal.en: Demagogue shares the leader half, so it means a leader of people, not of children.
normal.cn: demagogue 共享「引导者」一半，所以它指引导人民的人，而非孩子。

abstract.en: Picture an old servant carrying a lamp ahead of a boy on a dark road.
abstract.cn: 想象一个老仆提着灯，走在男孩前面的暗路上。

abstract.en: Picture a teacher who corrects a visitor's grammar before saying hello.
abstract.cn: 想象一位教师先纠正来访者的语法，再打招呼。

abstract.en: Picture a schoolroom where one figure stands at the front and everyone else listens.
abstract.cn: 想象一间教室，一个人站在前面，其余人都在听。

examples.en: The old pedagogue knew every family in the valley by name.
examples.cn: 那位老教师能叫出河谷里每一户人家的名字。

examples.en: Critics called him a pedagogue rather than a thinker.
examples.cn: 批评者称他是教书匠，而非思想家。

examples.en: In the ancient household, the pedagogue carried the boy's books and walked behind him.
examples.cn: 在古代家庭里，教仆拿着男孩的书，走在他后面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「派达 够格」——提灯送孩子上学的老仆人 → 教师、教书匠

root: 希腊 paidagogos「送男孩上学的家奴」= pais「孩子」+ agein「引导」；经拉丁 paedagogus 进入英语。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses begin with the schoolmaster, then move to the pedantic teacher, the college teacher, the educational writer, the ancient slave escort, the drillmaster, the symbol of authority and finally anyone who leads a learner.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从教书先生出发，转到卖弄学问的教师、大学教师、教育著作家、古代教仆、操练者、权威象征，最后是任何引导学习者的人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: an old servant with a lamp walks a boy to school and waits outside the wall.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个提着灯的老仆把男孩送到学堂，然后在墙外等候。

branches.en: THE TITLE: the schoolmaster and the college teacher, neutral names for the person.
branches.cn: 称号：中小学教师与大学教师，都是对人的中性称呼。

branches.en: THE SNEER AND THE DRILL: showing off learning, then reducing teaching to repetition.
branches.cn: 讥讽与操练：先是炫耀学问，再把教学缩减为重复。

branches.en: WRITER AND SYMBOL: the person who writes about teaching, and the figure who stands for school authority.
branches.cn: 作者与象征：写教学的人，以及代表学校权威的形象。

branches.en: THE ORIGINAL ESCORT: the slave who walked the boy and carried his books.
branches.cn: 最初的护送者：走在一旁、拿着书本的家奴。

branches.en: THE LEADER OF A LEARNER: the widest reading returns to the Greek image of guiding.
branches.cn: 学习者的引导者：最宽的读法回到希腊语的引导意象。

intro.en: Pedagogue is the Greek compound of a child and a leader, carried into English through Latin.
intro.cn: pedagogue 是希腊语中「孩子」与「引导者」的复合词，经拉丁语进入英语。

latinIntro.en: Greek pais and agein give paidagogos; Latin paedagogus gives English pedagogue, while the field word adds pedagogy and pedagogical.
latinIntro.cn: 希腊 pais 与 agein 构成 paidagogos；拉丁 paedagogus 衍生英语 pedagogue，领域词再加 pedagogy 与 pedagogical。

items.exampleCN: 第一个成分命名学习者。

items.example: The second element names the leading.
items.exampleCN: 第二个成分命名引导。

items.example: Agogos makes the leader.
items.exampleCN: agogos 造出引导者。

items.meaning: the slave who led a boy
items.example: The original compound named a servant.
items.exampleCN: 最初的复合词命名仆役。

items.example: Latin widened the servant to a tutor.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语把仆役扩展到导师。

items.example: English narrowed it to the teacher.
items.exampleCN: 英语把它收窄到教师。

items.example: The field word is a later formation.
items.exampleCN: 领域词是后来形成的。

items.example: The adjective describes method.
items.exampleCN: 这个形容词描述方法。

items.example: The longer adjective is the common one.
items.exampleCN: 较长的形容词更常用。
